cohort: The study included 255 women with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) and a latency period of at least one week.
finding: The safety of outpatient management for appropriately selected patients with PPROM is comparable to in-hospital management.
mod_finding: Precipitous vaginal delivery of a preterm breech infant was associated with mortality.
gest_age: The study involved women with PPROM, and a subgroup prior to 28 weeks' gestation was highlighted as potentially unsuitable for outpatient management.
